form.label: Hosts
form.description: Per-host inventory and findings, split by the filesystem root each component came from.

search.query: index=riskability_inventory sourcetype=riskability:swinv | stats count BY hostname | fields hostname

index=riskability_inventory sourcetype=riskability:swinv hostname=$hostname|s$ | stats latest(os_id) AS os, latest(os_version_id) AS release, latest(architecture) AS arch, latest(machine_id) AS machine_id, count AS components, latest(_time) AS last_scan BY hostname | eval last_scan = strftime(last_scan, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
index=riskability_inventory sourcetype=riskability:swinv hostname=$hostname|s$ | stats dc(name) AS components BY type | sort - components
`riskability_latest_inventory` | search hostname=$hostname|s$ | riskabilitymatch | eval root = if(scope_id!="", scope_id, "host") | stats dc(cve_id) AS cves BY root | sort - cves
`riskability_open_findings` | search hostname=$host_tok|s$ | eval sev = coalesce(severity, "unrated") | stats dc(cve_id) AS cves BY sev, ecosystem | sort - cves | fields sev, ecosystem, cves

viz.option: No open findings for this host. That can also mean the host has not reported inventory recently — check its last scan time above.

search.query: `riskability_latest_inventory` | search hostname=$hostname|s$ | riskabilitymatch | eval root = if(scope_id!="", scope_id, "host") | table cve_id, package, ecosystem, installed_version, fixed_version, root, confidence, epss, title | sort - epss
